root: ^You can also send your employees out on an Acquisition!
^The Acquisition page lets you see which Mortems are out in the world and need to be dealt with.
^It's the perfect way to find new Mortems for the Observatio!
^You can assign up to 4 employees to an Acquisition.
^They'll all go out together, and it'll be up to you to make sure that they all get through it intact.
^If you succeed, you'll get a new Mortem for your facility!
^...though at the moment, there's only one Mortem to acquire...
^...and it's a really tough one too...
^Still, you don't have to do an Acquisition the moment it appears. Take the time you need to ready your employees!
^...And Mote means REALLY ready. This Mortem is a higher class than even the Rabbit...
^In any case, Mote trusts that you'll make the right decision!
